# Phase 37 — Release Readiness

Use release-readiness skill and qe-architect. Assess scope, requirement/AC coverage, CI, test results, defects, security/privacy/content rights, platform API permissions, model availability, GPU compatibility, migrations, backup/restore, monitoring, rate limits, cost limits, feature flags, rollback and runbooks. Make a go/no-go recommendation with evidence. Do not release or deploy without explicit `APPROVE RELEASE <VERSION>`.
